title: A family of Hurwitz polynomial vector fields in $\mathbb{R}^3$ having non-constant periodic orbits
summary: We construct a two-parameter family of polynomial vector fields in $\mathbb{R}^3$ and prove that, on a nonempty open set of parameter values, every member of the family is Hurwitz and possesses two non-constant periodic orbits, one of saddle type and one attracting. This answers Problem 19 in Gasull's list of open problems on low-dimensional dynamical systems concerning the existence of non-constant periodic orbits in Hurwitz smooth vector fields on $\mathbb{R}^3$.
